_comment: Flat basin floor for the Frostpeak caldera plateau. The terrain VALUE is flat so the plateau top is level. horizontalScale trades off two failure modes: too WIDE and a small child patch can't ramp up to its full flat value (caps low, ~Y118); too SMALL (e.g. 4) and the rim shows NONE-like 1-block pillars. With a larger caldera patch (parent childShrinkFactor 1.6) scale 8 both reaches the flat top and blends the rim smoothly.
